answer: A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the canyon graph. Re-attestations are stored in ocean and delta lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 14 epochs, so holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 799 impostors cost 840 times the honest price and take 26 times as long to clear. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
